about: Stone, both stromatolites and the twelve plants on a REAL Gleba surface with gleba_plants and gleba_stone at their defaults, gleba_enemy_base and gleba_cliff at size 0 and cliff richness 0, otherwise as the graded arm. Each entity is [name index, x * 256, y * 256], listed when floor(position) is in the window or the one-tile ring around it. autoplacers (with collision mask flags) and tiles are read from the prototypes at runtime; fields are calculate_tile_properties at positions (512 overall, then 128 where each plant probability is above 0), as f32 hex bits. Written by FMW_ARM=plants scripts/probes/gleba-entities/capture.ts.
